---
title: Mayoral administrations
---

This compares route miles that were installed during each administration window. Mayor information from [Wikidata](https://www.wikidata.org/).

```{python}
from IPython.display import HTML

from bike_routes.charts import (
    display_light_and_dark,
    mayors_chart,
    mayors_with_miles,
    top_installers_table,
)
from bike_routes.repositories import MayorSnapshotRepository, RouteSnapshotRepository

routes = RouteSnapshotRepository().load()
mayors = mayors_with_miles(routes, MayorSnapshotRepository().load())
```

```{python}
#| renderings: [light, dark]
display_light_and_dark(mayors_chart(mayors))
```

## Top installers

```{python}
HTML(
    top_installers_table(mayors).to_html(
        index=False, border=0, classes="table table-sm"
    )
)
```
